items.text: Nomusi uyo Dhibhora naBharaki mwanakomana waAbhinoami vakaimba rwiyo urwu runoti:
"Inzwai izvi, imi madzimambo! Teererai imi vatongi!
Makomo akadengenyeka pamberi paJehovha, Iye weSinai,
uye hakuna nhoo kana pfumo zvakaonekwa
Tapa vatapwa vako, iwe mwanakomana waAbhinoami.'
Vamwe vakauya vachibva kwaEfuremu, midzi yavo yakanga iri muna Amareki;
Bhenjamini akanga ari pakati pavanhu vakakutevera iwe.
kubva kuZebhuruni avo vanotakura tsvimbo yomutungamiri wehondo.
Mudunhu raRubheni makanga muno kunzvera kwomwoyo kukuru.
Uye akagara zvake panopinda mvura dzegungwa.
Vanhu veZebhuruni vakaisa upenyu hwavo panjodzi;
asi havana kudzoka vakatakura sirivha, kana zvakapambwa.
akaropafadzwa kwazvo kupfuura vakadzi vagere mutende.
akamuvigira mukaka wakakora mundiro yakafanira makurukota.
Vakadzi vokwake vakachenjera kukunda vose vanomupindura;
'Ko, havasi kuwana nokugoverana zvakapambwa here vachiti,
musikana mumwe chete kana vaviri pamurume mumwe chete,
"Saka vavengi venyu vose ngavaparare, imi Jehovha!
Ipapo nyika yakava norugare kwamakore makumi mana.
